{{Top|leg}}
The '''Sacred Precinct''' was the term given to the [[Senate District/Legends|Senate District]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], after the planet was captured by them in the [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Battle of Coruscant]]. It contained [[Shimrra's Citadel]], the [[Well of the World Brain]], the [[Prefectory of Yuuzhan'tar]], and the [[Square of Hierarchy]].
